example.title: Miller homestead, horse barn, 2913 Kansas Highway 4
example.place: La Crosse vicinity, Rush County, KS

brief: Front-gabled horse barn about 40 ft wide and 50 ft deep, re-sided in pale grey shingle siding with bright red doors and window trim: a red Dutch door and red board doors at ground level, a red hinged hay door in the gable with a big white initial painted on it, and a red-framed loft window above. The galvanized metal roof, streaked with rust, sweeps down on one side over a long lean-to aisle (saltbox profile), and a low shed-roofed pen addition runs off the other side. Heavy pole-and-plank corral fences, cedars and cottonwoods around it.
